uniteMoveEffects.name: Big Jaw Bite
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: The user becomes Unstoppable while letting out an intimidating growl, reducing move cooldowns by 40% of the remaining cooldown, and reduces move cooldowns by 40% of the max cooldown for future move uses while this move is active for up to 15s. Additionally the user's tenacity is increased by 30% for 15s. When this move is used again, the user becomes Unstoppable and charges at the designated Pokémon from the opposing team and sinks their teeth into them, dealing damage. The amount of damage dealt is based on the number of Fang marks applied by Crunch. Unite buffs: 50% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
